assumptions.name: post-key-length-dispatch
assumptions.note: L independent of everything: flip to an 18-char id takes the guid branch of post_key; every other PC/note must be unchanged (the posts note mentions the dimension and is excluded on both sides)

assumptions.name: vis-not-found-foreclosure
assumptions.note: V gates VP and the author/public lookups

assumptions.name: author-not-found-foreclosure
assumptions.note: AU gates AUP and the public lookup

assumptions.name: public-not-found-foreclosure
assumptions.note: PU==True -> 404: gates PUP and the comment level

assumptions.name: comment-mention-free-foreclosure
assumptions.note: HM gates the mention_lookup_* family (unpersisted side)

assumptions.name: comment-link-free-foreclosure
assumptions.note: HD gates the whole diaspora:// link family: no link -> no entity compare, no link-count chain, no Post.exists? probe (message_renderer.rb:118-123)

assumptions.name: link-entity-foreclosure
assumptions.note: the FIRST link's entity: `comment` issues no query (message_renderer.rb:121 `Regexp.last_match(2) == "post"`)

assumptions.name: link-count-ge2-foreclosure
assumptions.note: N3-2 cardinality chain: no 2nd link -> no 2nd exists? probe and no ge3 decision

assumptions.name: link-count-ge3-foreclosure
assumptions.note: N3-2 cardinality chain: no 3rd link -> no 3rd exists? probe and no ge4 decision

assumptions.name: link-count-ge4-foreclosure
assumptions.note: N3-2 cardinality chain: no 4th link -> no 4th exists? probe (4 = the modelled 'four or more')

assumptions.name: mention-display-name-foreclosure
assumptions.note: N3-3: with a display name PeopleHelper#person_link never calls Person#name, so the name -> fix_profile -> Discovery -> reload chain of the mention rep is closed (people_helper.rb:28-33)

assumptions.name: mention-person-missing-foreclosure
assumptions.note: M-3: mentions.person_id has NO foreign key (schema.rb:202-209). Not found -> the preload issues the people SELECT and STOPS: no profiles step, no decisions of that rep; json renders [null], mobile 500s

assumptions.name: mention-person-profile-missing-foreclosure
assumptions.note: has_one :profile of a mentioned person: found -> no fix_profile/discovery/reload for that rep

assumptions.name: author-profile-missing-foreclosure
assumptions.note: has_one :profile of the comment author: found -> no fix_profile/discovery/reload for that rep

assumptions.name: comment-collection-empty-foreclosure
assumptions.note: M-4: an EMPTY comments relation issues nothing below itself — no representative row, no includes preload, no per-comment decision (Associations::Preloader#preload returns early on zero records; real run r3-empty-collection-*: 2 statements total) (round 4: flip_to is pinned to 0 because the length domain is now {0,1,MANY} and the richest snapshot seeds 2 — the auto int flip would give 3, which is outside the domain and evidence-identical to 2)

assumptions.name: principal-person-missing-foreclosure
assumptions.note: D5: people.owner_id has no FK; a signed-in user with no people row 500s at evil_query.rb:116 after the vis SELECT (and, under an inflected locale, in set_grammatical_gender before it)

assumptions.name: principal-profile-missing-foreclosure
assumptions.note: N3-1: the principal's has_one :profile, read by set_grammatical_gender; missing -> Module::DelegationError in the callback, before the action body

assumptions.name: principal-locale-inflected-foreclosure
assumptions.note: N3-1 / Rule G: users.language decides whether set_grammatical_gender runs at all. Not inflected -> no profiles read on the principal (adversary B09 `pl` vs B11 `en`). Corpus seeds this dimension only to 'pl', so the auto string flip ('pl' -> '') is the real non-inflected arm

assumptions.name: mention-discovery-failed-foreclosure
assumptions.note: targets.rb 8e: DiscoveryError -> fix_profile propagates (500 terminal) / find_or_fetch rescues to nil (no retry lookup)

assumptions.name: sti-out-of-tree-foreclosure
assumptions.note: M-6: posts.type outside the Post STI tree. AR raises SubclassNotFound while INSTANTIATING the row the finder returned, so the post finder is the last statement — no comments SELECT, no preloads, no exists? probes. Real run concrete_manifest_r4.rb r4-sti-out-of-tree-anon-json: one `posts` statement per request

assumptions.name: sti-out-of-tree-vis-foreclosure
assumptions.note: M-6 on the signed-in visibility finder: whichever of the three finders returns the row is the one that raises; the comment level is never reached (r4-sti-out-of-tree-auth-json)

assumptions.name: principal-locale-invalid-foreclosure
assumptions.note: M-5: a non-nil users.language that is not an available locale makes set_locale raise I18n::InvalidLocale BEFORE the action body — the whole data access is the `users` SELECT (r4-locale-invalid). Corpus seeds this dimension mostly to 'pl', so flipping TO 'xx' is the real third arm; NULL is not it (r4-locale-null-control 200s)

assumptions.name: comment-collection-many-foreclosure
assumptions.note: N4-3: the 1-vs-MANY half of the collection length. The real Preloader emits `col = ?` for one owner row and `col IN (?, …)` for two or more — both shapes measured in r4-preload-one-author / r4-preload-three-authors — so the flip must change the preload notes' predicate operator

assumptions.name: author-preload-keys-many-foreclosure
assumptions.note: M-7: the preload binds the DISTINCT author ids, so ten comments by one author give `people.id = ?` and two authors give `IN (?, ?)` (real runs r5-preload-one-distinct-key / -two-distinct-keys). One distinct key also forecloses the step's second-key outcome

assumptions.name: mention-preload-keys-many-foreclosure
assumptions.note: M-7 on the mentions chain: the person step binds the distinct mentions.person_id values

assumptions.name: mention-preload-second-key-missing-foreclosure
assumptions.note: M-8: the NESTED step binds the parents ACTUALLY LOADED — two mentions with one dangling give `people.id IN (?, ?)` then `profiles.person_id = ?` (real run r5-nested-shrinks-dangling), while two live ones give IN then IN (r5-nested-both-loaded)
